NPS 9 — Product is the backbone of our ML pipeline. The new monitoring dashboard saved us hours debugging a data drift issue last week.
Champion (VP Product) departed for a competitor. New VP Product starts May 5. Need to rebuild executive sponsorship before Q3 renewal.

Re: Ticket #44291 — engineering shipped a fix in 2.4.7. Customer confirmed export now completes in <2 min for their largest dataset.

Customer mentioned they were evaluating CompetitorX in a casual conversation. Said they're not actively switching but want to keep options open.
